rows.he: רִגְזוּ וְאַל תֶּחֱטָֽאוּ; אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹֽמּוּ, סֶֽלָה.
rows.en: Tremble, and do not sin; commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still.

rows.he:
אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ
בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא.
rows.en:
He is the eternal Lord who reigned
Before any being was created.

rows.he:
לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל
אֲזַי מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
rows.en:
At the time when all was made by his will,
He was at once acknowledged as King.

rows.he:
וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל
לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלוֹךְ נוֹרָא.
rows.en:
And at the end, when all shall cease to be,
The revered God alone shall still be King.

rows.he:
וְהוּא הָיָה, וְהוּא הֹוֶה
וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
rows.en:
He was, he is, and he shall be
In glorious eternity.

rows.he:
וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי
לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּֽירָה.
rows.en:
He is One, and there is no other
To compare to him, to place beside him.

rows.he:
בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית
וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
rows.en:
He is without beginning, without end;
Power and dominion belong to him.

rows.he:
וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גֹּאֲלִי
וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה.
rows.en:
He is my God, my living Redeemer,
My stronghold in times of distress.

rows.he:
וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי
מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
rows.en:
He is my guide and my refuge,
My share of bliss the day I call.

rows.he:
בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי
בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִֽירָה.
rows.en:
To him I entrust my spirit
When I sleep and when I wake.

rows.he:
וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי
יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
rows.en:
As long as my soul is with my body
The Lord is with me; I am not afraid.

rows.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּפִּיל חֶבְלֵי שֵׁנָה עַל עֵינַי, וּתְנוּמָה עַל עַפְעַפָּי.
rows.en: Blessed art thou, Lord our God, King of the universe, who closest my eyes in sleep, my eyelids in slumber.

rows.he: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, שֶׁתַּשְׁכִּיבֵֽנִי לְשָׁלוֹם וְתַעֲמִידֵֽנִי לְשָׁלוֹם.
rows.en: May it be thy will, Lord my God and God of my fathers, to grant that I lie down in peace and that I rise again to life.

rows.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, יְיָ אֶחָד.
rows.en: Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.

rows.he: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
rows.en: Blessed be the name of his glorious majesty forever and ever.

rows.he: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל מְאֹדֶֽךָ. וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה, אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם, עַל לְבָבֶֽךָ. וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ, וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ, וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ, וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ. וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶֽךָ, וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ. וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ.
rows.en: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might. And these words which I command you today shall be in your heart. You shall teach them diligently to your children, and you shall speak of them when you are sitting at home and when you go on a journey, when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes. You shall inscribe them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

rows.he: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ בַּיּוֹם, בָּרוּךְ יְיָ בַּלָּֽיְלָה; בָּרוּךְ יְיָ בְּשָׁכְבֵֽנוּ, בָּרוּךְ יְיָ בְּקוּמֵֽנוּ.
rows.en: Blessed be the Lord by day; blessed be the Lord by night; blessed be the Lord when we lie down; blessed be the Lord when we rise up.

rows.he: הִנֵּה לֹא יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל.
rows.en: The Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.

rows.he: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי; פָּדִֽיתָה אוֹתִי, יְיָ אֵל אֱמֶת.
rows.en: Into thy hand I commit my spirit; O Lord, faithful God, thou savest me.

rows.he: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּֽיתִי, יְיָ.
rows.en: For thy salvation I hope, O Lord.

rows.he: אָבִֽינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַֽיִם, צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹאֲלוֹ, בָּרֵךְ אֶת מְדִינַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, רֵאשִׁית צְמִיחַת גְּאֻלָּתֵֽנוּ. הָגֵן עָלֶֽיהָ בְּאֶבְרַת חַסְדֶּֽךָ, וּפְרוֹס עָלֶֽיהָ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ; וּשְׁלַח אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ לְרָאשֶֽׁיהָ, שָׂרֶֽיהָ וְיוֹעֲצֶֽיהָ, וְתַקְּנֵם בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ.
rows.en: Our Father who art in heaven, Protector and Redeemer of Israel, bless thou the State of Israel which marks the dawn of our deliverance. Shield it beneath the wings of thy love; spread over it thy canopy of peace; send thy light and thy truth to its leaders, officers and counselors, and direct them with thy good counsel.

rows.he: חַזֵּק אֶת יְדֵי מְגִנֵּי אֶֽרֶץ קָדְשֵֽׁנוּ, וְהַנְחִילֵם אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְשׁוּעָה, וַעֲטֶֽרֶת נִצָּחוֹן תְּעַטְּרֵם; וְנָתַתָּ שָׁלוֹם בָּאָֽרֶץ, וְשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם לְיוֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ.
rows.en: O God, strengthen the defenders of our Holy Land; grant them salvation and crown them with victory. Establish peace in the land, and everlasting joy for its inhabitants.

rows.he: וְאֶת אַחֵֽינוּ, כָּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, פְּקָד־נָא בְּכָל אַרְצוֹת פְּזוּרֵיהֶם, וְתוֹלִיכֵם מְהֵרָה קוֹמְמִיּוּת לְצִיּוֹן עִירֶֽךָ, וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם מִשְׁכַּן שְׁמֶֽךָ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ: אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם, מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶֽךָ. וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶל הָאָֽרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁוּ אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ, וִירִשְׁתָּהּ.
rows.en: Remember our brethren, the whole house of Israel, in all the lands of their dispersion. Speedily let them walk upright to Zion thy city, to Jerusalem thy dwelling-place, as it is written in the Torah of thy servant Moses: “Even if you are dispersed in the uttermost parts of the world, from there the Lord your God will gather and fetch you. The Lord your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it.”

rows.he: וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵֽנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶֽךָ, וְלִשְׁמוֹר אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתֶֽךָ. הוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶֽךָ, וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְּאַפּוֹ: יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶֽלֶךְ, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה, אָמֵן סֶֽלָה.
rows.en: Unite our heart to love and revere thy name, and to observe all the precepts of thy Torah. Shine forth in thy glorious majesty over all the inhabitants of thy world. Let everything that breathes proclaim: “The Lord God of Israel is King; his majesty rules over all.” Amen.

notes.text: רגזו fear God; אמרו בלבבכם על משכבכם that is, let the voice of your conscience make itself heard in the silence of the night; ודמו put an end to your striving after vanity, and repent.

סלה occurs seventy-one times in the Book of Psalms. It is derived from סלל (“to lift up”). In Psalm 68:5, the word סלו is used synonymously with שירו and זמרו in the sense of “extol, exalt.” Hence, it is safe to assume that סלה was a direction to the singers to raise their voices before certain pauses. In the writings of medieval Hebrew poets, however, סלה frequently connotes “forever.”

אדון עולם treats of God’s omnipotence and providence. This noble hymn has been attributed to various poets, particularly to Solomon ibn Gabirol who flourished in Spain during the eleventh century. It has been part of the morning service since the fifteenth century. It is composed of ten lines, each of which consists of twelve syllables. A single rhyme runs through it.
ועם רוחי גויתי... conveys the idea expressed in Sifré, section 139: שכל זמן שאדם נתון בחיים, נפשו פקודה ביד קונו... מת, נתונה באוצר...

rubrics.israel_author_en: By the Chief Rabbinate of Israel
